narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Arizona brought isolated flash flooding.
ev: A thunderstorm with heavy rain produced heavy runoff into washes and roadways. One barn northeast of Shumway had water running through it (2 inches in 45 to 60 minutes). .
Flooding was reported on McLaws Road in Holbrook.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 3 ESE SNOWFLAKE. HEAVY RUNOFF INTO WASHES AND ROADWAYS.
SHERRIFF DEPT. REPORTED FLOODING ON MCLAWS RD. IN HOLBROOK AZ.
HAD FLOODING THROUGH OUR BARN AND THROUGH OUR ANIMAL PENS. PROBABLY GOT ABOUT 2 INCHES OF RAIN IN 45 MINUTES TO AN HOUR.
